messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "take a single dose at least 2 hours before exercise for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction"
set: ["take a single dose at least 2 hours before exercise for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "take at least 2 hours after an antacid", "do not take another dose for at least 24 hours", "take at least 2 hours before antacid containing aluminum and magnesium hydroxide", "do not take an extra dose to treat exercise-induced bronchoconstriction", "stop using for at least 48 hours before test", "take 2 hours before or after sucralfate", "take liquid medicine on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before a meal or 2 hours after a meal", "use 2 inhalations 15 to 30 minutes before you exercise to prevent exercise-induced bronchospasm", "given for at least five days before the dose is increased", "2 hours", "taper dose gradually over at least a week", "stop using at least 2 months before planning to get pregnant"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
